topSignals.title: Bloom Energy hits record $329 on surging AI power demand
topSignals.text: — Shares jumped 15% on June 18 to a record close of $328.91 (+219% YTD), as Q1 2026 revenue came in at $751M (+130% YoY) and management raised full-year guidance to $3.4–3.8B backed by a $20B backlog. Oracle expanded its commitment to up to 2.8 GW total, with an initial 1.2 GW contracted for Project Jupiter (New Mexico). InvestorIdeas | StocksToTrade

topSignals.title: FERC issues Section 206 orders to all US grid operators on large-load interconnection
topSignals.text: — On June 18, 2026, FERC launched "aggressive targeted action" at its open meeting, issuing tailored orders to all US RTOs/ISOs to reform large-load (>20 MW) interconnection rules; each operator must address five key issues including alternative transmission technologies, cost transparency, and co-located load study processes. Longer grid queues (5+ year delays) directly strengthen the on-site SOFC value proposition. FERC press release | Utility Dive

topSignals.title: Ceres Power raises £103M and launches 10.8 kW data-center stack
topSignals.text: — New shares began trading on the London Stock Exchange on June 12, 2026; proceeds go toward commercial scale-up and partner support. Separately, Ceres unveiled a new 10.8 kW solid oxide stack aimed specifically at on-site data-center power and green hydrogen production cost reduction. Globe and Mail | Gasworld

items.text: Ceres Power £103M raise + 10.8 kW stack — see Top Signal #3. Doosan Fuel Cell (Ceres licensee) opened a 50 MW factory in South Korea in 2025 for natural-gas stationary systems; new stack targets data centers and low-cost green H2. Gasworld

17th European SOFC & SOE Forum — Scheduled June 30 - July 3, 2026 (Lucerne). Largest annual European SOFC research/industry event; watch for stack efficiency, degradation, and manufacturing announcements next week. EFCF

Sunfire focus shift — Sunfire spun off its fuel cell business in 2024 to concentrate fully on SOEC (electrolysis); retained a combined backlog of >800 MW. Competitive implication: one fewer European SOFC stack supplier in the pure-power segment.

Market size — SOFC market valued at $2.89B in 2026; projected $16.53B by 2031 (41.7% CAGR). Bloom, Mitsubishi Power, Ceres, Sunfire, and FuelCell Energy hold ~60% of manufacturing capacity. Mordor Intelligence

Oracle Project Jupiter (New Mexico) — Up to 2.45 GW Bloom SOFCs replacing previously planned gas turbines + diesel generators; single microgrid campus; 92% NOx reduction vs. gas turbines; announced April 27, 2026. Oracle | DCD

Crusoe + Tallgrass Cheyenne AI Factory — 1.8 GW campus, 900 MW Phase 1 with Bloom SOFCs; specifically chose fuel cells to bypass grid interconnection queue; first data halls targeted for late 2026. enkiai.com
Equinix + Bloom — Expanded agreement for >100 MW SOFCs across 19+ data centers.
FuelCell Energy + SDCL — Strategic collaboration to jointly market and finance up to 450 MW of fuel cell systems for data centers globally. enkiai.com
Bloom + Brookfield $5B deployment partnership — Brookfield to fund Bloom SOFC deployments at AI data centers. DCD

FERC large-load interconnection orders (June 18, 2026) — See Top Signal #2. FERC directed RTOs/ISOs to develop tailored rules; key issues include alternative transmission technologies and cost transparency. FERC | Utility Dive

US ITC 48E — Effective for projects beginning construction after Dec 31, 2025, the OBBBA removes the zero-GHG-emissions requirement: natural gas, biogas, and blended fuel cells all qualify for the 30% Investment Tax Credit. Project Finance Law Q&A | Climate Solutions Law

EU Cloud & AI Development Act (CADA, June 3 2026) — EU Tech Sovereignty Package commits to tripling EU DC capacity in 5-7 years (~€200B investment); Commission to develop minimum energy performance standards for data centers (needs assessment due 2027). Jones Day | Energy Connects

Germany EnEfG amendment (April 2026 draft) — Data centers going live from July 2026 must achieve PUE ≤ 1.2 and ERF ≥ 10%; 15% waste heat reuse required from July 2026 (20% from 2028); 100% green electricity from Jan 2027. SOFC heat-recovery (CHP) mode may help operators meet waste-heat targets. Orrick

SMR/nuclear wave — As of May 2026, all major hyperscalers have signed at least one nuclear deal; 13 announced projects totaling >9.8 GW. Amazon signed a new 1,920 MW PPA with Talen Energy (TLN) through 2042, with SMR exploration in Pennsylvania. Microsoft holds 835 MW TMI Unit 1 restart (first electrons 2027). SMR Intel | enkiai.com

CCGT capex inflation — New combined-cycle gas turbine plants now cost $2,000–2,200/kW (up from $1,300/kW in 2023), narrowing the SOFC cost gap in $/kW terms at scale. LCOE for new CCGTs: $45–100/MWh depending on gas price and capex.

Competitive position — SOFC 90-day deployment vs. 5+ year grid queue, and the ITC 48E credit, are the key differentiators over both CCGTs (slower, grid-dependent) and nuclear (10+ year lead times). Battery storage at $25/MWh LCOE (solar+storage) remains cheapest but unsuitable for 24/7 baseload AI workloads.

Bloom Energy (BE) — Record close $328.91 (June 18, +15.4% single day); +219% YTD. Q1 2026: revenue $751M (+130% YoY). FY2026 guidance: $3.4–3.8B revenue. Backlog: $20B. Oracle deal total: up to 2.8 GW. Nebius Group MOU: up to $2.6B over three 10-year phases. SEC 8-K Q1
FuelCell Energy (FCEL) — Q2 FY2026 (ended April 30, 2026) reported June 8, 2026. Backlog: $1.14B (down ~9.9% YoY from $1.26B). SEC 8-K

SOFC market — Global market $2.89B in 2026, projected $16.53B by 2031 at 41.7% CAGR. Fuel cells poised to capture ~1/3 of data center power demand by 2030 per some analyst forecasts. Mordor Intelligence

Frontiers Energy Research (2025) — "Progress and outlook of solid oxide fuel cell technology for stationary power generation applications" — reviews cogeneration/trigeneration (Rankine/Brayton exhaust integration) and identifies high ceramic stack cost ($4,000–6,000/kW vs. $1,000 target) as the central barrier. Frontiers

Springer Journal of Solid State Electrochemistry (2025) — "Three decades of solid oxide fuel cell research: trends, challenges & future directions" — broad survey covering thermal stress, electrode degradation, and scaling. Springer

ScienceDirect review (2025) — "A review of solid oxide cell technologies for power, fuel, and reversible energy storage" — covers reversible SOC (SOFC/SOEC dual-mode) as key for future data-center + grid-balancing use cases. ScienceDirect
Watch: 17th EFCF (June 30 - July 3, Lucerne) — expect new stack efficiency data, durability results, and manufacturing cost disclosures from European players.

lcoe.text: SOFC system capex: $4,000–6,000/kW (current commercial); long-term target $1,000/kW. Frontiers
SOFC LCOE range: $130–205/MWh at $4/MMBtu natural gas; $150–225/MWh at $8/MMBtu. With CHP heat monetization: $120–200/MWh at $4/MMBtu. Base case: ~$6,000/kW capex, no CHP. ScienceDirect DC LCOE study
US natural gas price: EIA outlook — $4.00/MMBtu avg 2025, $4.90/MMBtu forecast 2026. EIA AEO 2026
CCGT capex: $2,000–2,200/kW in 2025 (up from $1,300/kW in 2023); LCOE $45–100/MWh.
Solar + battery storage: $25.11/MWh LCOE (most competitive on paper, but 24/7 baseload unsuitable).

ITC 48E benefit: 30% capital cost credit applicable to all fuel cell feedstocks (natural gas, biogas) for projects starting construction post-2025 — effectively reduces capex to $2,800–4,200/kW before financing.
